2.4.1.3-r1.burton_quote: as to help concoction, to cleanse the brain, expel all careful thoughts, and anxious imaginations
2.4.1.3-r1.translation: Its proper virtue is to make the mind cheerful.

2.4.1.3-r2.burton_quote: not against poison only, falling sickness, and such as are vertiginous, but to this malady; the root of it taken by itself expels sorrow, causeth mirth and lightness of heart

2.4.1.3-r3.burton_quote: it purgeth all choler, and purifies the blood

2.4.1.3-r5.burton_quote: to expel vain imaginations, Devils, and to ease afflicted souls
